title: An LLM-Based Agent for Legal Compliance Assessment: Architecture, Memory, and Evaluation in a Canadian and Quebec Context
abstract: arXiv:2610.27347v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Checking whether a text complies with a body of law is slow when done by hand and fragile when done with keyword rules. This paper presents ComplianceAgent, the legal compliance sub-agent of COMPASS, a multi-agent framework that evaluates texts along four axes: digital sovereignty, carbon impact, compliance, and ethics. The agent relies on a large language model that scores a text on a fixed rubric, grounds its judgment in a reference legal corpus, and, when the score falls at or below a critical threshold, runs a corrective chain made of self-healing rewrites, a compliance label, an explainability report, and escalation to a human reviewer. We describe what the language model does at each step, how the memory of the agent is organized, and how the same implementation can be pointed at different reference corpora. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的法律合规评估智能体：加拿大与魁北克背景下的架构、记忆与评估
translated_abstract: 人工检查一段文本是否符合某一法律体系既耗时缓慢，而采用关键词规则的方法又十分脆弱。本文提出了ComplianceAgent，它是COMPASS框架中负责法律合规的子智能体。COMPASS是一个多智能体框架，从四个维度评估文本：数字主权、碳影响、合规性和伦理。该智能体依赖于一个大语言模型，该模型依据固定的评分标准对文本打分，并将判断锚定于参考法律语料库；当评分低于或等于关键阈值时，它会运行一条纠正链，包括自我修复式重写、合规标签、可解释性报告，以及升级至人工审核员。我们描述了语言模型在每一步中执行的操作、智能体的记忆是如何组织的，以及同一实现如何指向不同的参考语料库。我们在加拿大和魁北克的背景下对该智能体进行了评估，评估所用的语料汇集了十三个法律文件（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了ComplianceAgent——一个基于大语言模型的法律合规评估智能体，它依据固定评分标准对文本打分、将判断锚定于参考法律语料库，并在评分低于阈值时触发由自我修复重写、合规标签、可解释性报告和人工审核升级组成的纠正链，且在加拿大与魁北克十三个法律文件语料上进行了评估。
en_tdlr: This paper presents ComplianceAgent, an LLM-based legal compliance sub-agent that scores text on a fixed rubric grounded in a reference legal corpus, triggers a corrective chain of self-healing rewrites, compliance labeling, explainability reports, and human escalation when scores fall below a critical threshold, and is evaluated on thirteen Canadian and Quebec legal instruments.
